title: Derived-section vanishing at an affine inverse limit with Grothendieck coefficients
statement: Fix universes u and u′. Let S be a scheme in universe u, let A : Type u′ have Category.{u+1} A and IsGrothendieckAbelian.{u+1} A, and let F an A-valued small-etale sheaf on S, and D:I→Over(S), with I : Type u and SmallCategory I, a cofiltered diagram of qcqs schemes with affine transitions. Let c be a cone whose underlying scheme cone is a limit and q≥0. If R^qΓ(D_i,(D_i→S)^*F)=0 for every i, then R^qΓ(c.pt,(c.pt→S)^*F)=0. Here Γ is evaluation at the explicit identity etale object. This records the pre-existing generic coefficient theorem of the assigned source module, rather than changing the torsion abelian-group continuity statement of [lemma-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology-continuity].

proof.text: Apply scheme inverse-limit compactness and the affine projection theorem to show that the cone vertex is qcqs. Cofilteredness supplies a stage for the quasi-separatedness argument.

Use hypercover comparison and the concrete colimit universal property to identify the source theorem’s right-derived section objects, both at each stage and at the limit, with actual hypercover cohomology.

Every stage hypercover cohomology object is zero by the stage vanishing hypothesis and its comparison isomorphism. To prove the limit hypercover object zero, cancel its identity and zero morphism using joint generation by the stage objects. Every map with zero stage source has equal composites.
Transport IsZero back across the limit comparison isomorphism.

    (F : Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology A) {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsCofiltered I]
    (D : I ⥤ Over S) [∀ i, CompactSpace (D.obj i).left]
    [∀ i, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i).left] [∀ {i j} (g : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map g).left]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit ((Over.forget S).mapCone c)) (q : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ i, IsZero (((sectionsFunctor A (D.obj i).left).rightDerived q).obj
      ((Etale.upperStar A (D.obj i).hom).obj F))) :
    IsZero (((sectionsFunctor A c.pt.left).rightDerived q).obj
